proposal.reason: Both experiments with the initial policy and the revised policy (refresh_quote_before_order:true) achieved complete goal fulfillment, spending the same amount (430) and receiving all required items. The STALE_QUOTE error in both experiments was successfully handled by re-fetching quotes after waiting, confirming the policy's robustness.
